description: HIFLD Open USGS Hydro Network Linked Data Index (NLDI) Streamgage Monitoring Locations is a data set archived in DataLumos, the ICPSR archive of US government data, from the decommissioned Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data (HIFLD) Open portal (U.S. Geological Survey et al.). This dataset represents all Streamgage Monitoring Stations from the U.S. Geological Survey, for the United States, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands, in 2025. Gaging stations, or gages, measure the height (stage) and volume of flow at a point location on a water feature. Coverage: the United States (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and DataLumos (ICPSR) normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-datalumos-repository.
